name: System
description: CPU, GPU, memory, temperatures, battery, busy apps and network, measured while you look.
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Shows how your Mac is doing: CPU, GPU, memory, temperatures, battery, network and the busiest apps.
rules: It measures only while you're looking, so it costs nothing in the background.
The network part can show your public IP and test your speed when you ask.
